facts.business: Resonance Specialties Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and marketing of pyridine and pyridine derivatives, picolines, and some bulk drugs.
key_risks: Fluctuating prices of key inventory items (4CNP, Pyrazinamide, 2,6-L, 2,6-DPA-3P, 2,4,6-Collidine) dependent on international prices and conditions
Material regulatory and tax litigations with uncertain outcomes requiring significant judgement in provisioning and disclosures
Commodity price risk and foreign exchange risk (though stated as not materially exposed and no hedging activities)
facts.related_party_note: The Board has approved a policy for related party transactions uploaded on the company website. There were no materially significant related party transactions during the year that may have potential conflict with the interest of the Company. The Register of Contracts containing related party transactions is placed before the Board and Audit Committee regularly.
